input_hash.title: Input Hash
input_hash.description: 64-char hex SHA-256 of the agent's input.

output_hash.title: Output Hash
output_hash.description: 64-char hex SHA-256 of the agent's output / decision payload.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: Signature scheme when you supply a `signature`: "eip191" (EVM) or "ed25519" (Solana).

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: 0x-prefixed hex (eip191) or base58 (ed25519). Omit to have the anchor-x402 treasury sign for you (hosted-signer mode, for wallet-less agents).

signer_pubkey.title: Signer Pubkey
signer_pubkey.description: Required for ed25519 (Solana base58 pubkey). Ignored for eip191 — address is recovered.
